title: Seed and query local CAP data
audience: Full-stack developers new to SAP CAP

environment.description: Local development prototype; @sap/cds 10.1.1, @cap-js/sqlite 3.1.2, Node.js 22+ with node:sqlite. No SAP cloud account required.
prerequisites: Install Node.js 22.13+ (22 LTS recommended) and npm.
Run npm ci at the repository root before recording.
Use the checked-in inventory project; keep installation outside the video.

sources.title: SAP CAP: Serving OData APIs — Query Options

claims.text: This local inventory demo loads three products from the checked-in demo-Products.csv.
The demonstrated title-order query returns Mechanical Keyboard, Monitor Arm, then USB-C Dock.
The demonstrated stock-above-zero query returns the keyboard with 12 units and dock with 7, excluding the zero-stock monitor arm.

scenes.narration: Give your CAP demo real data.
The inventory service already exposes Products. Add predictable seed rows, then check what this local API returns.
Add this CSV under db slash data. Demo dash Products identifies our entity. Its header names ID, title, and stock.
Run npm run demo. Open Products ordered by title. Three seeded rows appear, including a monitor arm with zero stock.

visual.label: Captured result — title and stock shown

scenes.narration: Now filter stock greater than zero and order by title. The keyboard and dock remain. The response still includes each product's ID.

visual.label: Exact checked query — IDs also returned

scenes.narration: These are sample rows in a local, in-memory database. Development-only test data belongs in test slash data.

visual.label: Two products with stock — verified locally

scenes.narration: Try the checked-in project and its five checks. Which filter would you test next?
scenes.overlay: Try it. Then test your next filter.

publication.text:
Give a local CAP demo predictable data before connecting anything else.

This short uses the checked-in inventory service and demo-Products.csv. The live checks confirm three rows ordered by title. The exact stock-above-zero query returns Mechanical Keyboard (12) and USB-C Dock (7); Monitor Arm (0) is excluded.

The video cards show title and stock. The captured response also contains ID; this is not a payload-reduction example.

This sample uses an in-memory SQLite database. SAP distinguishes initial data in db/data (development and production) from development-only test/data. The sample rows here are for this local project, not a recommendation for productive data.

Code and setup: Code link pending repository publication
Initial-data guide: https://cap.cloud.sap/docs/guides/databases/initial-data
OData options: https://cap.cloud.sap/docs/guides/protocols/odata#feature-overview

Which stock threshold would you test next? That is an exercise; the demonstrated, asserted filter is stock greater than zero.
